headline: "Tax Accountants Set to Return Again"...Real Estate Tax Revised for the Ninth Time, With Over 10 Variables
summary: The government revised real estate taxes again, and calculating the comprehensive real estate tax and capital gains tax now involves more than 10 variables. Tax accountants are expected to return to handle the complexity.
why: Property taxes and capital gains rules shape housing demand, investment decisions and government revenue in South Korea.
